sections.title: About NCC
sections.content: Home About NCC About NCC National Cadet Corps MOTO OF NCC : UNITY AND DISCIPLINE 1(T) NAVAL UNIT, SECUNDERABAD GROUP, TROOP NO: 03, INSTITUTION & ANO CODE-TS11802 Admissions Events NCC Manual NCC Magazine Contact Us National Cadet Corps Act of 1948. It was raised on 15 July 1948 The National Cadet Corps T he NCC in India was formed with the National Cadet Corps Act of 1948. It was raised on 15 July 1948 The National Cadet Corps can be considered as a successor of the University Officers Training Corps (UOTC) which was established by the British in 1942. During World War II, the UOTC never came up to the expectations set by the British. This led to the idea that some better schemes should be formed, which could train more young men in a better way, even during peace times. A committee headed by Pandit H.N. Kunzru recommended a cadet organization to be established in schools and colleges at a national level. BACKGROUND: As you are fully aware that NCC plays a vital role in the growth and development of the country by grooming its most precious resource, youth. In order to attain our national goals it is imperative that our training encapsulates and embeds the qualities and attributes in the cadets. Apart from grooming and preparing the youth for the future challenges in NCC, cadets also get various benefits in terms of job opportunities , scholarships and financial assistance in times of any tragedy while undergoing any NCC related activity. INCENTIVES FROM THE CENTRE AND STATE GOVTS ADMISSION IN PRESTIGIOUS EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTES Many educational institutes have seats reserved for the certificate holders from NOC Preference is given in following fields (a) Degree and Diploma courses (b) LLB courses (c) Govt. Polytechnics and Engineering colleges (d) Medical courses RESERVED VACANCIES IN EMPLOYMENT CENTRAL GOVERNMENT JOBS: Specific vacancies in the Armed Forces via-Army, Air Force and Navy are reserved for NCC C Certificate holder candidates. Students opting for Officer Entry through UPS Care exempted from appearing in written examination and have the opportunity to appear directly at Interview by Service Selection Boards, (558) which is an important incentive as normal students have to toil hard in clearing written examination considering the standard of any UPSC exam. The other various incentives for NCC Certificate holders are as enumerated below. (i) Bonus marks are awarded in employment in Para Military Forces and Department of Telecommunication (ii) Can apply for gazetted post in CRPF if cadet holds third division degree in certificate examinations (iii) Employment within NCC Organization as Whole Time Lady Officer, (WTLO) Girl Cadet Instructor, various Instructor post such as Aero and Ship Modeling Instructor etc. STATE GOVERNMENT JOBS: Various states Government provide job incentive to the NCC ‘B’/’C’ certificate holders for recruitment in following departments: (a) Police Services. (b) Transport Department (c) Forest Department. (d) Excise Department. (d) Preference to the girl cadets as nurses, receptionists and telephone operators in various state Government sectors as well as private sector. For More Details Click on Download Download
